app.title: Sheaf
badge.text_title: This page already has a text layer
compress.low_hint: Repack only. Pictures stay exactly as they are.
compress.report: The result shows the size before and after.
crash.body: Something went wrong and the program has to close. Your original files were not changed. A short note without any document content was saved to:\n{path}
crash.title: Sheaf stopped unexpectedly
error.device: The scanner reported a problem. Check that it is on, connected and closed, then try again.
error.device_busy: The scanner is in use by something else.
error.engine_missing: A bundled component is missing or damaged.
error.io: The file system refused the request.
error.limit_exceeded: That is larger than the app allows.
error.no_paper: There is no paper in the feeder.
error.parse: That file could not be read as a PDF or image.
error.path_rejected: That file or folder cannot be used.
error.timeout: The job took too long and was stopped.
error.worker_crashed: The worker stopped. The job failed; try again.
export.flatten: Draw form fields into the pages (they stop being fillable)
export.hide_only: Cropped pages: hide the outside instead of removing it
export.hide_only_warn: Hide only: the cropped-away content stays in the file and can be read back.
export.name: File name
export.name_hint: {source}, {n}, {counter}, {date}, {match:pattern}. The file never replaces an existing one.
export.title: Export
fatal.hint: Reinstall the app or restore the missing files, then start it again.
fatal.title: Sheaf could not start
import.forms: {name} has form fields. They stay fillable only if you do not export it; exporting can draw their values into the pages.
import.network: {name} is on a network share: Windows contacts that server to read it.
lock.need_password: Enter a password to open or an owner password.
lock.owner_pw_hint: Lifts the restrictions. Empty means nobody can.
lock.remove_note: Saves a copy without a password or restrictions. You need the password to open the file first.
lock.strength: Encryption: AES-256. The result states what was applied.
lock.user_pw_hint: Leave empty to let anyone open the file with the restrictions below.
ocr.mode_add_hint: Pages that already have text are skipped. The file is saved on export.
ocr.mode_redo_hint: Replaces the existing text layer. Those pages are rebuilt as pictures on export.
ocr.mode_text_hint: Writes a .txt file and leaves the PDF as it is.
ocr.no_engine: The OCR engine is not installed.
ocr.title: Recognize text
password.label: Password
password.prompt: {name} is protected. Enter its password to open it.
password.title: Password needed
pdf2img.note: The pictures go into a new folder.
presets.hint: Name tokens: {source} {date} {n} {counter}. A run never replaces a file: a name that is taken gets -2, -3.
presets.name: Name
presets.none: No presets yet. Fill in the form and save one.
presets.title: Presets
preview.crop_apply_n: Crop the {n} selected pages the same way.
preview.crop_hint: Drag the frame. The area outside it is removed from the page.
preview.empty: Open a file to see its pages here.
preview.none_selected: Select a page to preview it.
preview.text_title: Show recognized text over the page
scan.hint: Pages appear in the tray as they are scanned. You can cancel at any time; the pages already scanned stay.
scan.none: No scanner found. Check that it is switched on and connected, then refresh.
scan.title: Scan
scan.unavailable: Scanning is not available on this computer.
search.label: Search recognized text
settings.about: Version {version}. Works offline; nothing leaves this computer.
settings.network_paths_hint: Reading a file from \\server\share makes Windows contact that server. Turn this off to keep the app fully offline.
settings.ocr_mode_hint: Takes effect for files opened from now on.
settings.title: Settings
settings.wheel_hotkey_hint: Like ctrl+alt+space; empty turns the wheel off. Takes effect when the tray helper restarts.
settings.workers_hint: 0 means all cores but one. Takes effect when the app restarts.
split.ranges_hint: Like 1-3, 5, 8-. Pages not listed are left out.
split.regex_hint: A page whose text matches starts a new file. Patterns are checked for safety.
split.text: Text on a page starts a new file
stamp.page_range_note: Pages are counted in the output file.
stamp.text_hint: {n} is the page number, {N} the page count.
